title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省 Espiritu市镇 Binacag 小学的名称变更为Quiaoit 纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Binacag Elementary School in the Municipality of Espiritu, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Quiaoit Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Binacag Elementary School in the Municipality of Espiritu, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Quiaoit Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Binacag tại Thị trấn Espiritu, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte thành Trường tiểu học Quiaoit Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Binacag ในเทศบาล Espiritu, จังหวัด Ilocos Norte เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Quiaoit Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Binacag di Kotamadya Espiritu, Provinsi Ilocos Norte menjadi Sekolah Dasar Quiaoit Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Binacag di Perbandaran Espiritu, Wilayah Ilocos Norte menjadi Sekolah Rendah Quiaoit Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5201_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Binacag Elementary School in the Municipality of Espiritu, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby changed to Quiaoit Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1968.
